findings.problem: The phrase 'en 4 semanas' is ambiguous and typically suggests a future timeframe ('in 4 weeks') rather than the intended preceding window ('within the last 4 weeks').
findings.en: Recent surgery or trauma (within 4 wk, needing hospitalization/GA)
findings.es: Cirugía o traumatismo recientes (en 4 semanas, con hospitalización/anestesia general)
